top_bugs_and_defects.description: Primary action button on FacilityDashboard is dead for CREATED referrals because handlePrimaryAction lacks a branch for CREATED.
CREATED referrals are not included in attention, monitoring, or completed filters, rendering them invisible in the operations center.
Hardcoded patientId = 'P-1001' prevents patients from seeing newly created referrals.
Referrals state is in-memory only; refreshing the browser destroys all user-created referrals and status advances.
Caregiver contact number is collected in the form and stored in state, but never rendered anywhere in ReferralDetails or dashboards.
Request Human Help buttons trigger browser window.alert promising follow-up, but perform zero state changes or notifications.

P0: Persist referrals to localStorage/mock DB so state survives refresh.
Remove hardcoded patientId = 'P-1001'; add referral/patient selector.
Fix dead action button on FacilityDashboard for CREATED status.
Connect 'Request Human Help' to set status to FOLLOW_UP_REQUIRED.
Display caregiver contact in ReferralDetails and Coordinator view.
P1: Add Care Navigator data entity and assignment workflow.
Support referral redirection and rejection with documented reasons.
Replace instant completion with structured clinical outcome modal.
Remove dead component files (ReferralCard, ReferralTimeline, StatusBadge) or consolidate.
P2: Add form validation (phone format, distinct source/destination facilities).
Add elapsed-time SLA warnings for overdue acknowledgements and arrivals.
Fix package.json lint script and update HTML title.
P3: Integrate SMS/WhatsApp notifications for community families.
Extend data model to support 42-day postpartum and neonatal continuing care.
